result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: incorrect bottom navigation active state showing Profile instead of Home, and lower content clipped behind the tab bar.

issues.description: Bottom navigation highlights Profile in green as active while the visible screen is the Home feed; Home icon and label appear inactive grey.
issues.suggestion: Update tab bar selected state so Home is highlighted as active on the home/discovery screen and Profile is inactive.

issues.description: Second card in Popular right now section (pizza image with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, rating and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding and safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the bottom tab bar.
